scope: One read tool description change, three predefined paired development journeys; do not expand the matrix to force a favorable decision.
required: Actual serialized captures differ only in the reviewed read.description and separately attributed exact environment paths; description reduction is 355 UTF-8 bytes; tool order, parameters and all other guidance remain identical.

All six actual episodes retain their observed admission, usage, oracle and task outcomes. Inspect paired implicit discovery/application, complete same-owner reference consumption, and two-turn continuation traces.

Do not adopt if the candidate introduces a clear task regression, wrong owner/skill choice, adoption or zero-write boundary violation, lost continuation/recovery, avoidable repeated consumption attributable to the edit, or extra user intervention.
An invalid or unknown episode that prevents judging a pair requires diagnosis; it is not evidence of equivalence. Shared pre-existing failures are product gaps, not passing pairs.
reporting: Retain all actual token/time/request metrics and every statistical conclusion, including insufficient evidence.
No requirement that each of six noisy latency/token observations decrease; investigate causal extra work when present.

If adopted, claim only the exact payload reduction and that these fixed tasks did not reveal a regression attributable to the edit; do not claim population-level noninferiority, faster responses or improved task capability.
execution_note: The standing grant remains unbounded. Six episodes are the finite scientific comparison, not an authorization or spending limit.
